children: Hayden Brown, President and CEO, sold 269,779 shares on November 18, 2026, at a weighted average price of $9.44; 79,483 shares on November 19 at $9.0557; and 112,703 shares on November 20 at a weighted average price of $8.84. The sales totaled $4,262,966. The November 18 sale was a sell-to-cover transaction to meet tax withholding obligations upon RSU vesting and was not a discretionary trade. Brown directly owned 378,450 shares after the transactions.
